financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 2,500,000 units (common stock plus warrants) at $5.00 per unit; closing date inferred from the 8-K filing date
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We will receive net proceeds from this offering of approximately $11,100,000 after deducting underwriting discounts and estimated offering expenses payable by us.

warrants.quote: Each unit consisted of one share of common stock and a seven-year warrant to purchase one share of common stock at an exercise price of $0.15 per share.
The warrants are exercisable immediately upon issuance at an exercise price of $0.30 per share and expire on the 66th month anniversary of the issuance date.
